caption: The drawing depicts a four-drawer wooden chest in a natural light-brown color, with visible wood grain patterns throughout its surfaces. The chest is rectangular and stands on short, curved legs that form an ornate base with a scalloped lower edge at the front. Each of the four drawers has two round wooden knobs for handles, evenly spaced. The sides of the chest are paneled, and there is beaded detailing that runs vertically along the front edges of the chest, adjacent to the drawers. The top of the chest is flat and slightly overhangs the body, with clearly depicted wood texture. The background is plain and off-white, with no other objects or designs present. Near the bottom right corner, the name “J.E. Darnall Jr.” is written in small, neat text.
title: Chest of Drawers
